senses.gloss:
ढौक् ढौक् (a form of त्रौक्), i. 1, Ātm. To approach, Śāk. 63, 14 C.
 --Caus.
 1. To offer, Rājat. 3, 445.
 2. To procure, Kathās. 26, 7.
 --With the prep. उप उप, Caus.
 1. To offer, Hit. 67, 20, v. r. उप टौकयामः.
 2. To perform, Pañc. 158, 4.
ढौकन ढौक् + अन, n. Bestowing, Rājat. 6, 166.
